content: Our visual storyteller incorporates a context encoder and multiple independent decoders to the image description architecture by BIBREF0 to generate stories from image sequences. Having an independent decoder for each position of the image sequence, allowed our visual storyteller to build more specific language models using the context vector as its first state and the image embedding as its first input. In the internal track of the Visual Storytelling Challenge 2018, we obtained competitive METEOR scores in both the public and hidden test sets and performed well in the human evaluation.
